products.name: Logic4 ERP
products.description: All-in-one back office for trading companies: PIM, pricing, order management, CRM, stock, purchasing, accounting and management information; sold in Smart (from EUR 499/month), Business (from EUR 999/month), Professional and Premium packages.

products.name: Logic4 Webshop
products.description: Webshop platform (webshop Next) integrated with the back office; multiple shops and labels, B2B portal, CMS and SEO tools; Logic4 states 500+ webshops run on it.

products.name: Logic4 Cloud POS (Multi-branch)
products.description: Cloud register for branches sharing master data with head office and keeping branch administrations.

products.name: Logic4 Warehouse App
products.description: Scanner app for picking, receiving and counting on location-based storage.

products.name: Logic4 Integrations and API
products.description: Connectors and API: marketplaces via EffectConnect, EDI, payment plugins, carrier platforms and Katapull sibling bridges; EDI/marketplace integrations are part of the Professional package.

products.name: Logic4 Implementation and Support
products.description: In-house implementation, data migration, support and free updates; Premium adds account manager, SLA and on-site onboarding.
